name: Character Flaw
body:
School enchantment; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one person
Duration 1 minute + 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The target of this spell becomes more unpleasant to those around him, and grates on them more often, fraying their tempers and making it impossible to influence them in any way he might desire (–10 to all Charisma– based checks). It is not that the target behaves any differently, but everything he says and does rubs people the wrong way. This spell shifts NPC attitudes toward the subject one step toward hostile for the duration of the spell. The subject may make a Diplomacy check to try to improve their attitude (at the –10 penalty), but failure by more than 5 is likely to worsen their attitude even further.
